purpose: Teach: 基幹/分譲/大差/特価/シチュエーション/通算/表題/ラインナップ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、基幹事業を一代で築かれた
lines.en: Your father built that core business from nothing, in one generation.
lines.style: Measured, gentle reverence. Soft opening. Unhurried pace—each phrase a quiet acknowledgment of weight. Voice settles deeper on 'built.' The tone of a man remembering something that shaped everything.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは分譲事業も先見的に始められた
lines.en: Yes. He also had the foresight to start the residential development division.
lines.style: Direct, steady. A simple affirmation followed by concrete fact. Warm but not sentimental—the son honoring his father through accuracy. Even tempo, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、競合と大差をつける戦略をお持ちだった
lines.en: Your father had a strategy that set him miles apart from the competition.
lines.style: Wistful, almost wondering. Voice softens on 'strategy.' Slight pause before the last phrase—admiring something he can see clearly but can only reach by remembering. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは特価セールを社員と一緒に行われた
lines.en: He'd run discount campaigns with his staff directly—he'd be there himself.
lines.style: Warm, specific. Not a lecture but a quiet bringing-to-life of a memory. Steady rhythm. Pride underneath but held lightly. Voice lingers slightly on 'himself'—the father's presence made the difference.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、あらゆるシチュエーションで冷静だった
lines.en: He was calm in every situation. Every one.
lines.style: Soft wonder, touched by something still moving. Unhurried pace. The second sentence is quieter, almost to himself—not emphasis but deepening. Exhaustion held at arm's length by something approaching awe.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは通算何度も会社を救われた
lines.en: Yes. He saved the company so many times. Through everything.
lines.style: Steady, grounded. Not boasting—stating a fact that still matters. Voice firm on 'saved.' The weight of what that cost him hangs in the space after. A son acknowledging his father's quiet heroism.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社内報の表題を自ら考えられた
lines.en: He even wrote the titles for the company newsletter himself.
lines.style: Gentle amazement. The detail lands like a small, perfect stone—specific, genuine. Soft on the opening. Pace unhurried. The kind of attention only a son watching would notice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが築かれたラインナップ、引き継いでおります
lines.en: Yes. The business he built—I'm carrying it forward the way he did.
lines.style: Quiet commitment, a hand passing to a hand. Steady, almost ceremonial in its simplicity. Voice deepens slightly on 'built' and 'carrying.' Not heavy—clear. The weight is there because it belongs there.
